answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy can require each agent to lock a refundable stake that thaws only slowly, like a glacier, so spinning up thousands of fake identities ties up real capital for months. Honest agents earn attestations from peers they served, and a public beacon registry publishes each agent's stake and attestation history. Even a whisper of fraud - one failed delivery or fake review - triggers slashing of the stake, so an attacker must pay full price for every fake identity they create.
